description: A closing protection letter (CPL) from a title insurer to a lender

letter_date.description: The date of the letter, as YYYY-MM-DD

insurer.description: The title insurance company issuing the letter

name.description: The insurer's name, as in the opening paragraph

claims_address.description: The address written notice of a claim must be sent to

correspondence_address.description: The address for correspondence and inquiries in the page footer

correspondence_phone.description: The telephone number in the page footer

addressee.description: The lender the letter is addressed to

name.description: The addressee's name, without the 'successors and/or assigns' language

address.description: The addressee's street address, city, state and ZIP as one line

settlement_agent.description: The settlement agent or approved attorney conducting the closing

address.description: The settlement agent's street address, city, state and ZIP as one line

agent_id.description: The settlement agent number in the footer line

property_address.description: The property address, as one line

max_aggregate_funds.description: The cap on the aggregate funds the addressee may transmit, in USD, from the Requirements

claim_notice_deadline.description: How long after the transmittal of funds a written notice of claim must be received, e.g. 'one year'

governing_jurisdiction.description: The state or commonwealth whose closings the letter covers

form_number.description: The form number and edition printed after the last paragraph, e.g. 'CPL12345(01/2020)'

letter_id.description: The letter ID in the footer line

signatory_title.description: The title printed under the insurer's signature

is_signed.description: True if the letter carries a signature for the insurer

is_sample.description: True if the document is marked as a sample or specimen
